decisions.reason: Individual spelling inspection does not change the requirement to begin image coverage at chapter 1 or its book-specific exception policy.
The source explicitly adds a mandatory validation and insertion condition to the Ontario driver license book image-addition task.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
When adding images to the ontario drivers license book, you must inspect what you added instead of blindly copy-pasting it into the word doc. If an image contains spelling errors, re-generate that image before adding it to the MS word file. This means checking each image one by one.

step 1: Generate the image

step 2: Verify that it is correct

step 3: If there is no spelling error, add it to the MS word file

value_updates.image_insertion_condition: Inspect each generated image individually and add it to the Ontario driver license document only after confirming that it contains no spelling errors.
value_updates.spelling_error_action: Regenerate any image containing spelling errors before adding it to the document.
